name: gov-portal-micro-frontends
description: Government Services Portal - Micro Frontend Workspace

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "SHELL,TAXES,PERMITS,LANDS,GRANTS,CASES,REGS" --prefix-colors "blue,cyan,green,yellow,magenta,red,white" "npm run dev:shell" "npm run dev:taxes" "npm run dev:permits" "npm run dev:lands" "npm run dev:grants" "npm run dev:cases" "npm run dev:registrations"
scripts.build: npm run build:mfes && npm run build:shell
scripts.build:mfes: concurrently --names "TAXES,PERMITS,LANDS,GRANTS,CASES,REGS" "npm run build:taxes" "npm run build:permits" "npm run build:lands" "npm run build:grants" "npm run build:cases" "npm run build:registrations"
